relevance.rationale: IDENTIFICATION FINDING: the filename says 'Ohtsuki-99' but the front matter identifies a 1999 Acta Mathematica Sinica (English Series) 15(3) 293-316 article by Xiaosong Lin and Zhenghan Wang, ON Ohtsuki's invariants — Ohtsuki is the subject, not an author. Anyone joining this row by filename will mis-key it. The paper gives explicit surgery formulae for Ohtsuki's rational invariants lambda_n of integral homology 3-spheres extracted from the Reshetikhin-Turaev SU(2) invariants, plus integrality results. It is core for one specific reason: it prints an independently computed numerical value of lambda_2 for the corpus's own keystone manifold, giving the Sigma(2,3,5) false-theta transcription a falsifiable external check it currently has none of. Citation status checked all three ways: no ref() id (no Lin, no Wang, no Ohtsuki lambda_n entry among the 481 ids), no cite{} in content/**/*.md, no '-- Ref:' in content/**/*.lean. Corpus-grep before declaring the gap: docs/audits/, content/, computations/, docs/coordination/ carry no Casson-invariant or Ohtsuki-series-of-a-3-manifold work at all (every 'Casson' hit is Casson-Rivin angle-structure duality), so no prior agent has already run this check. Note the same Ohtsuki-name collision as the sibling document: this is the lambda_n(M) series of homology spheres, not the 4_1 Kashaev kappa-tower of QOU/QBeta/OhtsukiTowerBarParity.lean.

keyResults.statement: If M is the Poincare homology 3-sphere Sigma(2,3,5), realised as +1-surgery on the right-handed trefoil, then lambda_2(M) = 39. (Companion: Sigma(2,3,7) from +1-surgery on the left-handed trefoil has lambda_2 = 63.)
keyResults.useForFolio: A parameter-free external number for the second Ohtsuki coefficient of S^3/2I. Expanding the corpus's Sigma(2,3,5) false theta in h = q-1 must reproduce it (together with lambda_1 = 6 lambda_Casson = ±6, the trefoil having a_2 = 1). This is the falsifiable check the keystone transcription lacks. Caveat that must be settled before the comparison means anything: Lin-Wang's orientation is +1-surgery on the RIGHT-handed trefoil, and their own Remark on the same page gives lambda_2(Mbar) = lambda_2(M) + lambda_1(M) under orientation reversal — so the corpus's orientation convention has to be fixed first, or the check will fail for a bookkeeping reason rather than a mathematical one.

keyResults.locator: Theorem 1.1 (p. 293) and Corollary 5.1 (p. 303), strengthened at Theorem 7.1
keyResults.statement: lambda_2(M) is an integer divisible by 3 for every integral homology 3-sphere M; lambda_1(M) is in 6Z (lambda_1 = 6 times the Casson invariant, Murakami).
keyResults.useForFolio: An integrality sieve on any lambda_n the corpus extracts from its own Sigma(2,3,5) series: a transcription that yields a non-integer, or an integer not divisible by 3 at n=2, is wrong independently of any numerical tolerance. Cheap, exact, and it fails loudly — the right kind of gate for a transcription check. Consistent with the quoted value (39 = 3 x 13).

keyResults.statement: Explicit surgery formulae expressing lambda_1 and lambda_2 of a manifold obtained by Dehn surgery on a unit-framed algebraically split link as sums over sublinks; specialised to 1/n-surgery on a knot K these express lambda_2 through Vassiliev invariants read off the Conway and Jones polynomials of K, and give lambda_2(M)/3 = mu(M) mod 2 with mu the Rokhlin invariant.
keyResults.useForFolio: Supplies a second, independent route to the same numbers that does not pass through the false theta at all: it computes lambda_n(Sigma(2,3,5)) from the Jones polynomial of the trefoil, an object the corpus already has full machinery for (Markov trace on H_n(q)). Two independent in-corpus computations of the same lambda_2 would make the check self-contained rather than dependent on a quoted literature value.

proposedActions.rationale: Orphan with no ref() entry. The entry must be keyed on Lin and Wang, not Ohtsuki — the filename invites exactly the wrong join, and the sweep has already recorded one wrong-join incident of this shape in the ledger. Metadata belongs in references.ts only.

Expand the corpus's Sigma(2,3,5) series in h = q-1 and compare lambda_1 against ±6 and lambda_2 against 39, after fixing the orientation convention against Lin-Wang's right-handed-trefoil normalisation; apply the lambda_2 in 3Z sieve as a precondition. This validates the transcription that the whole colored-WRT keystone step rests on. The external values are comparison targets, never inputs to be wired.
